📅 2025-09-13 Cessation of Operations INC-299
A strike on a nearby school caused significant damage to the centre forcing it to close

UNRWA was forced to suspend all health services in two facilities in Gaza City since 13 September after they sustained significant damage. This includes the suspension of activities at Beach Camp Health Centre, the only functioning UNRWA health centre north of Wadi Gaza. Previously, this facility provided health care services including outpatient care, Maternal and Child Healthcare, Physiotherapy, treatment for Non-Communicable Diseases and vaccination to over 1,000 patients on a daily basis. On 13 September 2025, an UNRWA health centre was reportedly indirectly impacted by an airstrike at the adjacent UNRWA school compound in Beach Camp, west of Gaza City. in the nearby areas in Beach Camp. Significant damage to the health facility and no casualties among UNRWA personnel were reported.

📅 2025-04-02 Unspecified INC-289
First floor of Jabalia health centre struck, destroying two rooms and killing 15 people sheltering there

On 2 April, the Israeli Forces hit two rooms on the first floor of an UNRWA destroyed Health Centre in Jabalia. The site was used as an UNRWA-managed shelter for 160 displaced families (or around 735 people) when it was hit. The UNRWA personnel managing the shelter did not receive any warning signals prior to the strike. Fifteen displaced people, including nine children, were reported killed in the strike. UNRWA Commissioner-General posted on X (previously known as Twitter) that “The total disregard of UN staff, premises or operations is a profound defiance of international law” and called once again for “independent investigations to find out the circumstances of each of these attacks and the serious violations.”

15 killed

📅 2023-11-12 Invasion / Ground Assault INC-253
Israeli forces invaded two health centres forcing IDPs to leave and firing artillery at the centres. They also allegedly used the centres for Israeli military operations.

UNRWA received extremely concerning reports that Israeli Security Forces (ISF) entered one school and two health centres in Gaza city with tanks and used the installations for military operations. The reports received by UNRWA state that ISF conducted interrogations and arrests of IDPs in the installations. In one health centre, five people were reportedly killed. According to the reports, IDPs were subsequently forced to leave the UNRWA installations and move south towards Wadi Gaza. Witnesses reported that Israeli Forces then struck the two health centres with artillery fire. UNRWA is further verifying these reports. If confirmed, the military use of UNRWA facilities raises serious concerns, as such use puts civilians at serious risk of harm. Directing attacks against civilian objects is a serious violation of international law. Health centres, in particular, are also afforded special protection against attack.

5 killed

Notes

Operated by UNRWA. Pre war there were 22 UNRWA health centres throughout Gaza. Since 7 October 2023 the number of centres that were operational changed month to month. Additionally, temporary health centres were established to meet increased demand, with an additional 5 facilities set up throughout the war (total of 27), although not all were oparational.

First floor of Jabalia health centre struck, destroying two rooms and killing 15 people sheltering there

📍 UNRWA Health Centre — Gaza City, Gaza

Summary

On 2 April, the Israeli Forces hit two rooms on the first floor of an UNRWA destroyed Health Centre in Jabalia. The site was used as an UNRWA-managed shelter for 160 displaced families (or around 735 people) when it was hit. The UNRWA personnel managing the shelter did not receive any warning signals prior to the strike. Fifteen displaced people, including nine children, were reported killed in the strike. UNRWA Commissioner-General posted on X (previously known as Twitter) that “The total disregard of UN staff, premises or operations is a profound defiance of international law” and called once again for “independent investigations to find out the circumstances of each of these attacks and the serious violations.”

Casualties

15Civilians killed

INC-253📅 2023-11-12Invasion / Ground Assault
×

Israeli forces invaded two health centres forcing IDPs to leave and firing artillery at the centres. They also allegedly used the centres for Israeli military operations.

📍 UNRWA Health Centre — Gaza City, Gaza

Summary

UNRWA received extremely concerning reports that Israeli Security Forces (ISF) entered one school and two health centres in Gaza city with tanks and used the installations for military operations. The reports received by UNRWA state that ISF conducted interrogations and arrests of IDPs in the installations. In one health centre, five people were reportedly killed. According to the reports, IDPs were subsequently forced to leave the UNRWA installations and move south towards Wadi Gaza. Witnesses reported that Israeli Forces then struck the two health centres with artillery fire. UNRWA is further verifying these reports. If confirmed, the military use of UNRWA facilities raises serious concerns, as such use puts civilians at serious risk of harm. Directing attacks against civilian objects is a serious violation of international law. Health centres, in particular, are also afforded special protection against attack.

Casualties

5Civilians killed

INC-252📅 2023-11-11Unspecified
×

Health centre in Rimal area of Gaza City impacted by a strike

📍 UNRWA Health Centre — Gaza City, Gaza

Summary

One UNRWA school and one health centre in the Rimal area of Gaza City were impacted by a strike. According to reports received by UNRWA between 1,000 and 2,500 IDPs were sheltering in the health centre. UNRWA was able to coordinate the safe evacuation of a group of IDPs from the health centre to the south of Wadi Gaza; however, the others still remain in the health centre.

INC-249📅 2023-10-11Siege (fuel shortage)
×

Two health centres are running critically low on fuel and will have to close if they do not get more

📍 UNRWA Health Centre — Gaza City, Gaza

Summary

Diesel reserves to run the health centres are critically decreasing. The current stock of diesel at Shaboura Health Centre in Rafah is for one day, while in Khan Younis health centre the stock is for two days. If stocks of diesel are not replenished by tomorrow (12 October), there is a high risk that these two health centres will have to close.
